CDS Protocol System

Overview

Chlorine Dioxide Solution (CDS) is an oxidative therapy consisting of 3000 ppm (0.3%) chlorine dioxide dissolved in water. It is distinct from MMS (Miracle Mineral Solution), which uses sodium chlorite activated with an acid.

Key Scientific Principles

  • Oxidative Therapy: CDS acts as a mild oxidant to support the body's natural oxidative immune mechanisms
  • Pathogen Support: CDS provides oxidative support against various pathogens including parasites, bacteria, and fungi
  • Detoxification: CDS supports the body's natural detoxification pathways
  • HCL Activation Preferred: Hydrochloric acid activation is preferred over citric acid for CDS preparation
  • CDS vs MMS: CDS at 0.3% concentration (3000 ppm) is chemically identical to activated MMS but pre-activated

Important Safety Notes

  • Protocol G - Gas: Gas inhalation is NOT recommended. CDS must NOT be inhaled
  • Protocol H - Home: Low-dose household support, not for clinical use
  • Protocol J - Joyful Mouthwash: Oral rinse only, not for systemic conditions
  • Always dilute CDS properly before consumption
  • Individual results may vary - consult a qualified healthcare practitioner
